theater: 平壤、安市城與鴨綠水流域

battle.name: 唐滅高句麗之戰
battle.theater: 平壤、安市城與鴨綠水流域
battle.brief: 乾封元年（666年）末，高句麗王族內訌，泉男生以安市城降唐求援；唐高宗遣李勣、契苾何力分道出師，總章元年（668年）正月安市城破，數日後平壤下，役終滅其國。卡面的秦弩出自秦始皇陵時代，標示弩機蓄力的技術源頭；本役城頭互射的，是同源的唐式弩與高句麗弩手，攻城靠砲車、撞車與雲梯。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭是唐與高句麗在東亞北部的一場總體對決，發生在唐高宗乾封元年（666年）末至總章元年（668年）。唐一方以行軍大總管制分道用兵：主力由李勣率領，自幽州、營州一線出遼東，向鴨綠水推進；契苾何力領另一支兵負責平壤以西及鴨綠水下游諸城；薛仁貴為先鋒將，負責突破城邑與打擊援軍；另有一路由劉仁願統率的百濟道兵力，用於牽制半島方向上的百濟故地與新羅，防止高句麗與百濟殘部合流。兵源主要為關內、河北、隴右各道府兵與募兵，糧秣自幽州、營州轉運，並可借渤海海道運糧，減少遼東陸路的消耗。高句麗一方由國王高藏坐鎮平壤，以鴨綠水與長白山地脈為天然屏障，沿線築城設柵，形成以安市城、平壤城、新城為骨幹的山城聯防；高句麗把王族分封與城防結合，山城居高臨下，守城時多倚賴固定射位、弓弩齊射與臨時構築的土壘。高句麗內部則有泉氏兄弟爭位，泉男生、泉男建、泉男產三方各有部眾與城邑，使抵抗並非整體一致。戰役之外，北方靺鞨粟末部與海上往來亦牽動全局，唐廷必須同時防備北方，避免因全力南向而空虛。整體而言，唐在兵員、後勤與攻城器械上佔優，高句麗在地形與城防上佔優，最終的差距由攻城技術與士氣決定。
countriesEn: This war was a general reckoning between Tang and Goguryeo in northeastern East Asia, fought from the end of the first year of Qianfeng (666) to the first year of Zongzhang (668). The Tang side fought under the system of Grand General of the March, with the force divided into several columns. The main army was led by Li Ji, advancing out of Liaodong along the Youzhou–Yingzhou line toward the Yalu River; Qibi Heli led another column to take the cities west of Pyongyang and along the lower Yalu; Xue Rengui served as the vanguard commander, responsible for storming walled towns and cutting off relief; and a separate force under Liu Renyuan operated on the Baekje route, to pin down the old Baekje lands and Silla on the peninsula and prevent Goguryeo from joining hands with surviving Baekje elements. The troops were drawn mainly from the militia and recruited soldiers of the Guannei, Hebei and Longyou circuits. Provisions moved forward from Youzhou and Yingzhou, and the sea route across the Bohai could be used to ship grain, easing the burden of the overland road through Liaodong. The Goguryeo side was anchored by King Gojang at Pyongyang, using the Yalu River and the Changbai mountains as a natural barrier, building cities and stockades along the line, and forming a linked mountain defence whose backbone was the cities of Ansi, Pyongyang and Sinch'ŏn. Goguryeo combined the enfeoffment of its royal clan with its fortification system; the hill cities looked down on the approaches, and the defenders relied on fixed firing positions, massed bow and crossbow fire, and hastily raised earthen works. Inside Goguryeo there was also a struggle among the brothers of the Quan family, with Quan Nansheng, Quan Nanjian and Quan Nanch'an each holding retainers and towns of their own, so the resistance was not a single coordinated effort. Outside the campaign proper, the Sushum Mohe in the north and maritime contacts also shaped the situation: the Tang court had to watch the north as well, so that the empire did not empty itself while everything was thrown into the south. Overall, Tang held the advantage in manpower, logistics and siege equipment, while Goguryeo held the advantage in terrain and fortification; the difference was settled by siegecraft and by the morale of the troops.
people: 唐高宗李治是這場戰爭的最高決策者：是否出兵、是否乘勝追擊平壤、是否在高句麗求降後罷兵，都由他在長安與諸將往返的奏議中裁定。主帥李勣（原名李世勣，避太宗諱改名）是全役的實際統帥，他以七十餘歲之齡自幽州一路東進，拔蓋牟城、渡鴨綠水，並在安市城下築土山逼城，最後主持平壤的受降與城破。契苾何力出身鐵勒部落，是唐軍中對高山、崎嶇地作戰最有經驗的將領之一，安市城與新城一線的攻堅多倚其力。薛仁貴以白袍先鋒聞名於此役，他在扶餘、新城一帶屢破高句麗兵鋒，並在高句麗以飛雲梯夜襲唐營時以火攻破之，穩住唐軍在遼東的攻勢。高句麗方面，王弟泉男生被兄長泉男建、泉男產排擠，以安市城降唐求援，成為唐軍深入的直接契機；泉男建後來據守平壤拒降，是高句麗最後的抵抗中心；泉男產奉兵符出降，代表高句麗主體向唐軍屈服。安市城守將高延壽、率高惠真力戰，城破後仍不肯降而被斬，成為此役最具象徵性的兩個人物。新城護軍渾牟在本土淪陷後仍率殘部據守新城抵抗，最終被契苾何力擒獲送往長安。此外，百濟故地與新羅之間的戰事由劉仁願一線的將領應付，其失利與退兵也從側面說明唐廷無法在同一時間對半島全線施壓。
peopleEn: Tang emperor Gaozong, personal name Li Zhi, was the ultimate decision maker of this war: whether to send the army, whether to press on to Pyongyang after the first success, and whether to stand down once Goguryeo had sued for peace, were all settled in his capital through the exchange of memorials with his commanders. The real field commander was Li Ji (formerly Li Shiji, renamed to avoid the taboo name of the Taizong), then over seventy years old, who drove east out of Youzhou, took Gimha, crossed the Yalu, built an earthen mound against Ansi, and finally presided over the surrender of Pyongyang and its capture. Qibi Heli, born into a Tiele clan, was one of the Tang commanders most experienced in fighting in high and broken country, and the sieges along the Ansi and Sinch'ŏn lines leaned heavily on him. Xue Rengui, famous in this campaign as the white-robed vanguard, repeatedly broke Goguryeo's relieving armies around the Puyo and Sinch'ŏn regions, and destroyed by fire a Goguryeo flying cloud ladder that attacked the Tang camp by night, which steadied the Tang offensive in Liaodong. On the Goguryeo side, the king's brother Quan Nansheng was squeezed out by his elder brothers Quan Nanjian and Quan Nanch'an, and with Ansi as his last refuge he surrendered to Tang and asked for help; that plea became the pretext for Tang's deep entry into the peninsula. Quan Nanjian later held Pyongyang and refused to surrender, remaining the last centre of Goguryeo resistance. Quan Nanch'an came out with the military tally to surrender, representing the bulk of the Goguryeo state as it submitted. The defenders of Ansi, Go Yonsu and Go Wi Hye-chin, fought hard and were executed after the city fell, which makes them the most symbolic figures of the campaign. The Sinch'ŏn protector Hunmok kept a remnant force in the field after the heartland was lost, and was finally captured by Qibi Heli and sent to the capital. In addition, the fighting between the old Baekje lands and Silla was handled by the commanders of Liu Renyuan's column, whose setbacks and withdrawal also show that the Tang court could not apply pressure along the whole peninsula at the same time.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩，是秦始皇陵時代的弩機形制：弩把弦的拉力儲存在機件之中，射手扣動機牙便可放弦，射速遠勝拉弓。它本身早於本役八百餘年，不會出現在平壤城下，但它確定了整個東亞攻城戰的技術源流：本役唐軍與高句麗用來對射的弩，正是這一路數沿襲下來的唐式弩與高句麗山城之弩，形制上同樣以弩機蓄力、分段瞄準、單人即可發射。弩在高句麗山城防禦中的意義最為關鍵：守軍居高臨下，弩手可以壓制正在填壕、逼近城牆、架設雲梯的唐軍，讓攻城者無法把器械推上牆頭；唐軍的弩手則在進攻序列中覆蓋城頭射界，壓制城頭守軍的射擊，為砲車、撞車與雲梯爭取時間。除了弩，真正決定攻城成敗的還有唐軍的攻城器械：砲車以投石遠程打擊城頭女牆，撞車用以撞擊城門與城牆，雲梯與布幔則是接近城頭與登城的工具；高句麗一方也造飛雲梯反攻唐營，可見雙方在器械上的攻防是同時進行的。除遠射與攻城器械外，弓、箭、刀、槊是近身與散兵的常備，披甲與長槊構成步戰骨幹；騎兵負責追擊、斷糧與搜索，並用於山地機動。糧秣方面，遼東至平壤四百餘公里的山地行程使海運與就地徵發極為重要，這一點比任何單一器械都更能左右遠征的成敗。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card face is in the form of the trigger mechanism of the Qin-dynasty crossbow as it comes down from the tomb of the First Emperor: the weapon stores the tension of the bowstring inside its mechanism, so that the archer only has to release the catch and the string flies, giving a rate of fire far beyond that of a drawn bow. The weapon itself predates this campaign by more than eight hundred years and would never have appeared beneath the walls of Pyongyang, but it fixed the technological ancestry of siege warfare across East Asia. The crossbows with which the Tang troops and the Goguryeo defenders actually shot at each other in this campaign were the direct descendants of that line: the Tang crossbow and the hill-fortress crossbow of Goguryeo, which in the same way stored their power in a mechanism, were aimed in stages, and could be worked by a single man. The crossbow mattered most in the mountain defence of Goguryeo: the defenders held the high ground, and their crossbowmen could pin down the Tang troops who were filling the ditch, closing on the wall, or raising the cloud ladders, so that the besiegers could never get their equipment up onto the parapet. The Tang crossbowmen, for their part, covered the firing lanes over the wall during the assault, suppressing the defenders' shooting and buying time for the stone-throwers, the battering rams and the ladders. Beyond the crossbow, the siege equipment of the Tang army really decided the outcome: the stone-throwers struck the parapets at long range, the battering rams were driven against gates and walls, and cloud ladders and hides were the means of reaching and mounting the wall. Goguryeo also built flying cloud ladders of its own and counter-attacked the Tang camp with them, which shows that the two sides were contesting with equipment at the same time. Alongside bows, arrows, sabres and spears, which were the common kit of close combat and of loose-order fighting, armour and long spears formed the backbone of the infantry line; cavalry handled pursuit, cutting of supplies and scouting, and provided mobility in the hills. On the logistic side, the mountainous stretch of more than four hundred kilometres between Liaodong and Pyongyang made seaborne transport and local requisition enormously important, and this told on the success of the expedition more than any single piece of equipment.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術骨架，是唐軍用多路並進、步步設營與攻城器械的組合，去消耗高句麗的山城防禦。乾封二年（667年）正月，李勣等分道出師，每路先鋒清除沿途的城邑與柵寨，後隊以輜重、攻城車與糧隊跟上，避免單一深入。渡過鴨綠水之後，唐軍利用高句麗城邑之間的傾軋與望風披靡，逐個拿下蓋牟、平壤以西諸城，戰線不斷向西南推進。安市城攻防是全役的樣板：高句麗據城固守，利用山城高度、狹窄的進攻面與城頭齊射，令唐軍的雲梯難以同時展開；唐軍則在城東築起土山迫近，把弩手與砲車搬上高處，用弩箭與飛石反向覆蓋城頭，使守軍無法俯射，之後再以撞車與步卒接近城門。至於平壤，高藏遣泉男產奉兵符出降之後，李勣仍圍城進攻，最終在攻城器械與突擊配合下破城，泉男建被俘。高句麗方面的戰術是典型的以逸待勞、以小拒大：把糧秣儲在城內，用出城反擊與遲滯消耗遠征者的糧秣與士氣，等待援軍、等待天時。北方冬季的嚴寒與河川凍結、難以輓運的季節限制，令唐軍更倚重海運；一旦糧道或海道被切斷，遠征便無法維持。
tacticsEn: The tactical skeleton of this war was the Tang combination of advance along several columns, careful establishment of each camp, and siege equipment, used to grind down the mountain defences of Goguryeo. In the first month of the second year of Qianfeng (667), Li Ji and the others set out in separate columns; in each column the vanguard cleared the towns and stockades along the road, while the train of baggage animals, siege wagons and supply wagons followed behind, so that no single column pushed deep alone. After the Yalu was crossed, the Tang army exploited the divisions among Goguryeo's towns and the collapse of morale, taking Gimha and the cities west of Pyongyang one after another, and the line of advance kept moving south-west. The siege of Ansi is the model of the whole campaign: Goguryeo held the city firmly, using the height of the hill city, the narrow approach and massed firing from the wall, so that the Tang could not unfold their cloud ladders all at once. The Tang in turn pushed an earthen mound up on the eastern side of the city, brought crossbowmen and stone-throwers onto that high ground, and covered the parapet from above with crossbow bolts and flying stones so that the defenders could not shoot down, and only then brought the battering rams and infantry up against the gate. At Pyongyang, after King Gojang sent Quan Nanch'an out with the military tally to surrender, Li Ji still continued the siege, and the city was finally taken with the help of the siege equipment and an assault, with Quan Nanjian captured. Goguryeo's own tactics were the classic ones of a smaller force wearing out a larger one: keeping grain inside the walls, using counter-strikes and delays to drain the expedition's supplies and morale, and waiting for relief and for the season. The severity of the northern winter, and the season's freezing of the rivers that made hauling and supply so difficult, made the Tang army lean even harder on seaborne transport; once the land route or the sea route was cut, the expedition simply could not be sustained.
data: 本役可用的數字有限，且多為概數，必須分辨哪些是史書明載、哪些只是估算。年份最為清楚：高句麗王族爭位、泉男生降唐求援在唐高宗乾封元年（666年）十二月；唐廷下詔出兵在乾封二年（667年）正月；安市城破與平壤城破都在總章元年（668年）正月，其後數月契苾何力擒新城護軍渾牟，高句麗才告全面覆亡，全役歷時約兩年。兵力方面，《資治通鑑》記唐軍出兵「十餘萬」，但並無分道編制的細帳；高句麗方面的兵員，諸史只概稱「眾」一類的總數，並未分列各城守兵，確數不可考，因此不宜用雙方總數相減的方式推算勝負。距離可以估算：安市城（今遼寧海城一帶）距平壤（今朝鮮平壤）直線約四百公里；蓋牟城（今吉林集安一帶）距平壤約二百餘公里；唐軍自幽州出發、經鴨綠水至平壤，路線多在山地與河川交錯地帶。安市城被圍攻數月不下，一度築土山逼近，其工程量可見一斑。行政層面上，唐於高句麗故地置平壤都護府，領九都督府及州縣，並把降附之民編入唐籍、徵收租庸，具體數目史無明文，只存於制度記載。兵器方面，秦弩的射程沒有同時代文獻可依，出土弩機的尺度與箭鐫長度只容許作約數估算，約在一百數十步上下；至於本役所用的唐式弩，規格已與秦弩不同，這類估算只能當作量級參考。
dataEn: The figures available for this campaign are limited and mostly round numbers, so it is necessary to separate what the histories record outright from what is only an estimate. The chronology is the clearest part: the struggle inside the Goguryeo royal house and Quan Nansheng's surrender to Tang in supplication fall in the twelfth month of the first year of Qianfeng (666); the Tang court ordered the army out in the first month of the second year of Qianfeng (667); the fall of Ansi and the fall of Pyongyang both came in the first month of the first year of Zongzhang (668), and a few months later Qibi Heli captured Hunmok, protector of Sinch'ŏn, after which Goguryeo was completely extinguished; the whole campaign thus lasted about two years. On numbers of troops, the Zizhi Tongjian records the Tang force as 'more than one hundred thousand', but no detailed account of the establishment of the separate columns survives; for Goguryeo the histories give only general totals such as 'the multitude', without listing the garrison of each city, so the exact figures are not recoverable, and it would be wrong to subtract one side's total from the other's to decide the issue. Distances can be estimated: Ansi, in the area of modern Haicheng in Liaoning, lies about four hundred kilometres from Pyongyang in a straight line; Gimha, near modern Ji'an in Jilin, lies a little over two hundred kilometres from Pyongyang; and the route the Tang army took out of Youzhou, by way of the Yalu to Pyongyang, runs mostly through country where hills and rivers interlace. Ansi held out for months under siege, and the Tang built an earthen mound against it, which shows how heavy the work was. At the administrative level, Tang established a Protectorate at Pyongyang over the old Goguryeo lands, with nine commanderies-in-chief and a number of prefectures and counties, and registered the surrendered people in Tang households, subject to tax and corvée; the precise numbers are not recorded and survive only as institutional description. As for arms, there is no contemporary document that gives the range of the Qin crossbow, and the excavated mechanism and the length of the arrowheads permit only a rough estimate, on the order of a hundred-odd paces; the Tang crossbow used in this campaign was of a different specification from the Qin weapon, so such estimates can serve only as a sense of magnitude.
cause: 唐與高句麗的對抗並非一次偶然的衝突，而是有兩百年以上的邊界糾葛。漢末到隋代，高句麗在遼東半島建立並鞏固王國，逐步兼併扶餘、漢江以北之地，又阻斷中原通往東北的陸路通道，成為唐在東北推進的障礙。隋煬帝三征高句麗皆告失敗，耗盡國力，給了高句麗喘息與坐大的空間，也讓唐初對半島採取謹慎的羈縻政策：封高句麗王為郡公、郡王、國王，靠冊封維持關係。第一次高句麗之戰（唐太宗貞觀十九年，645年）中，唐軍雖攻破數城，卻在安市城與平壤城下受挫，兵力與糧秣消耗殆盡，最後以「人不勝兵」罷兵。此後二十餘年雙方無大戰，但高句麗依舊控制東北通道，並與北方靺鞨往來密切，唐廷對此並不滿意。直接引爆本役的，是高句麗內部的王位之爭：高藏的兄弟泉氏互相傾軋，泉男生被排擠到安市城，走投無路之下向唐請援；唐高宗抓住這個機會，藉「救一國之君」的名義出兵，實質是趁亂取地。與此同時，半島上百濟遭新羅攻擊，唐廷必須阻止新羅坐大，也不願高句麗與百濟聯手，故此番出兵並非單純為了響應高句麗的求援。
causeEn: The confrontation between Tang and Goguryeo was not an accidental clash but the outcome of two centuries of friction along the frontier. From the late Han through to the Sui, Goguryeo had founded and consolidated a kingdom on the Liaodong peninsula, gradually absorbing Puyo and the lands north of the Han river, and it blocked the overland route from the central plains into the northeast, becoming the obstacle to Tang expansion there. The three Sui campaigns against Goguryeo all ended in failure and drained the state's strength, which gave Goguryeo room to recover and grow, and which also pushed early Tang policy on the peninsula towards a cautious form of indirect rule: the Goguryeo king was enfeoffed as commandery lord, then prince, then king, and relations were maintained through investiture. In the first Goguryeo campaign, fought by Emperor Taizong in the nineteenth year of Zhenguan (645), the Tang army did take several cities, but was checked before Ansi and Pyongyang, spent its soldiers and its provisions, and finally withdrew with the admission that the army could not be sustained. No major war followed for more than twenty years, yet Goguryeo still controlled the northeastern corridor and kept up close intercourse with the Mohe to the north, which did not satisfy the Tang court. What actually set off this campaign was a struggle for the throne inside Goguryeo: the Quan brothers of King Gojang fell out among themselves, Quan Nansheng was driven back to Ansi, and with nowhere left to turn he appealed to Tang for help. Emperor Gaozong seized the opportunity and went out under the banner of saving a neighbouring king, in substance taking advantage of the disorder to seize territory. At the same time, Baekje on the peninsula was being attacked by Silla; the Tang court could not afford to let Silla grow strong, nor did it want Goguryeo to link up with Baekje. This dispatch of troops was therefore not simply an answer to Goguryeo's appeal.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果，是唐第一次真正解決了高句麗問題，東北門戶洞開，也第一次把唐的行政機構與軍制推到平壤城下。唐於平壤置都護府，領九都督府及若干州縣，把高句麗降附之民編戶齊民，配屬唐籍，徵收租庸，並在高句麗故地重新劃郡縣，漢式州縣與里坊制度首次深入到鴨綠水以北。就長期後果而言，這一舉動的走向比唐廷當時想像的複雜：北方渤海國在二十多年後崛起，以高句麗故地為核心建國，幾乎全面接收了高句麗的疆域與人口；半島上的新羅也乘唐軍北撤之際逐步南下，先後取平壤、貝水一帶，唐置於平壤的都護府維持不了多久，終為新羅所據，安東都護府一系亦隨之裁撤，而統一新羅則在八世紀初統一三國。唐在東北的經營因此只是打開了一個窗口，並未建立永久的直轄秩序。戰役本身的代價也留給了後世：遠征消耗了河北、隴右的府兵與大量糧秣，為唐中期府兵制的崩壞與募兵制的興起添了一筆；而「平壤都護府」這類名義上的極盛疆域與實際控制力之間的落差，成為後世史家衡量唐前期對外戰爭成敗的典型案例。
impactEn: The outcome of this war was that Tang solved the Goguryeo problem for the first time in earnest: the gate to the northeast was thrown open, and for the first time Tang administration and military institutions were carried to the walls of Pyongyang. Tang set up a protectorate at Pyongyang with nine commanderies-in-chief and a number of prefectures and counties, registered the surrendered and subject people of Goguryeo in Tang households, levied tax and corvée upon them, and re-drew the commanderies and counties on the old Goguryeo lands, so that the Chinese-style prefectural and ward system reached for the first time north of the Yalu. As to the long-term consequences, the direction of the affair turned out to be more complicated than the Tang court imagined at the time: the northern state of Balhae rose some twenty years later and founded itself around the old Goguryeo lands, taking over almost the whole of Goguryeo's territory and population; Silla on the peninsula also pressed south as the Tang army withdrew northward, taking Pyongyang and the Paisu region in turn; the protectorate Tang had set up at Pyongyang could not be held for long and finally fell to Silla, and the Eastern Capital Protectorate line was wound up with it, while Unified Silla completed the unification of the three kingdoms in the early eighth century. Tang's engagement with the northeast therefore only opened a window rather than establishing a permanent direct rule. The cost of the campaign was also left to later generations: the expedition consumed the militia of Hebei and Longyou and a great quantity of grain, adding to the strain that would break down the fubing system of the mid-Tang and bring the recruited soldier to the fore; and the gap between the paper grandeur of a protectorate at Pyongyang and the reality of Tang control has become a standard case through which later historians measure the success and failure of Tang's early foreign wars.
result: 總章元年（668年）正月，唐軍在安市城取得決定性突破：安市城破，守將高延壽、率高惠真被斬，首級送京；同年平壤城破，高句麗王高藏遣泉男產奉兵符出降，泉男建被俘；其後數月，契苾何力攻取新城、擒新城護軍渾牟，殘餘的高句麗勢力被掃平。歷時七百餘年的高句麗王國至此中斷，其地在法理上歸入唐朝版圖，唐設平壤都護府管治，並封高藏為高麗王，泉男產、泉男生等亦有封授，留在唐境的原高句麗官員與部眾多被編入唐籍。但軍事上的終結不等於治理的完成：唐軍主力班師之後，新羅步步緊逼，平壤最終在數十年內落入新羅之手，高句麗的疆土與人口先為渤海、後為新羅所分取，漢人郡縣建置大體無存。若以結果論，唐贏得了對高句麗的軍事勝利，卻沒能守住這份勝利所留下的秩序。就兵器而言，一件源於秦代的弩機所代表的技術譜系，在這場戰爭裡以唐式弩與高句麗弩的形式，決定了城頭射界的較量，而最後定下勝負的仍是攻城器械、糧秣與士氣。
resultEn: In the first month of the first year of Zongzhang (668) the Tang army achieved the decisive break at Ansi: the city fell, the defending commanders Go Yonsu and Go Wi Hye-chin were executed and their heads sent to the capital; in the same year Pyongyang fell, King Gojang sent Quan Nanch'an out with the military tally to surrender, and Quan Nanjian was taken prisoner; a few months afterwards Qibi Heli took Sinch'ŏn and captured Hunmok, protector of Sinch'ŏn, and the remaining Goguryeo forces were swept away. The kingdom of Goguryeo, which had lasted more than seven hundred years, was thereby brought to an end; in law its territory passed into the Tang empire, Tang set up a protectorate at Pyongyang to administer it, Gojang was enfeoffed as king of Goryeo, and Quan Nanch'an and Quan Nansheng also received titles, while many former Goguryeo officials and people who stayed in Tang territory were registered as Tang households. But a military conclusion is not the same as a completed administration: once the main body of the Tang army went home, Silla pressed forward step by step, and Pyongyang passed into Silla's hands within a few decades; Goguryeo's lands and people were first taken over by Balhae and then divided up by Silla, and the Chinese commanderies and counties established there largely did not survive. Judged as a result: Tang won the military victory over Goguryeo, but failed to preserve the order that victory left behind. As for the weapon, the technological lineage represented by the Qin trigger mechanism played out in this war in the form of the Tang crossbow and the Goguryeo crossbow, and it was they that settled the contest for the firing lanes over the wall; what decided the outcome in the end was still the siege equipment, the supplies and the morale of the troops.
